lede: Gold dropped below $3,800 in Asian trade for the first time since September 2025, squeezed by a dollar near 19-month highs and a December Fed hike priced at about 95%. Wall Street fell for a fourth day before Nvidia's results, which beat forecasts and lifted the stock after hours; the FOMC minutes at 22:00 TRT are today's main event.
snapshot_time: Gold 05:42 TRT · EURUSD ~07:00 · GBPUSD & US500 Tue close · Brent 05:35 TRT

focus.text: Down ~1.4% near $3,796, a 14-month low, after NY Fed's Williams said another hike is likely needed. FOMC minutes at 22:00 TRT are today's key risk.
Stuck around 1.0990–1.1000 after touching a 19-month low on Tuesday; strong German ZEW gave little lift. UK CPI at 10:00 and FOMC minutes at 22:00 TRT set the tone.

technicals.indicators: Hourly RSI ≈ 30 (near oversold) · below 50- and 200-day MAs · lowest since Sep 2025
technicals.note: A string of lower highs from 4,140 down to 3,891 continues, and the break of the 3,815–3,835 shelf turned it into the first resistance zone.

technicals.indicators: Lowest since April 2025 · DXY near 103.6, a 19-month high · 61.8% Fibonacci retracement at 1.0902
technicals.note: The pair is hugging the 1.10 handle after slipping below it intraday, with the October range floor near 1.11 now well overhead.

technicals.indicators: Six-session losing run halted Tuesday (+0.1%) · price pinned to the 1.32 area
technicals.note: Cable is basing just above 1.3185 after its slide, with today's UK CPI the near-term catalyst for the range.

technicals.indicators: Weekly RSI ≈ 38 · below 200-day and 200-week MAs · sixth straight weekly loss
technicals.note: Bitcoin is boxed in a 63,800–65,700 range since the weekend low near 62,000, inside a weekly structure of lower highs since the 2025 peak.

calendar.event: UK CPI (Oct) — exp 3.6% y/y, prev 3.5%; core exp 2.8%

news.text: S&P 500 lost 1.0% to 7,341 and the Dow 1.7%, a fourth straight decline with every sector lower amid AI-spending doubts.
Nvidia's quarterly revenue jumped 103% to $115.8bn and it guided to about $130bn next quarter; shares rose after hours following a weak regular session.
NY Fed's Williams sees another hike as likely needed; futures price roughly a 95% chance of a December quarter-point move.
October retail sales rose 0.2% as expected while the control group beat at 0.6%; builder sentiment fell to its lowest since April 2012.
Brent eased to about $92.6 after API reported a 5.3m-barrel US crude build, with Iran and Hormuz shipping risks limiting losses.
Spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $8m on Monday, ending a seven-session outflow run of about $1.9bn; IBIT drew $76.5m.
Ether ETFs saw about $8.3m of net outflows on Monday, with Fidelity and Grayscale funds leading redemptions.
Strategy shares fell 6.3% Tuesday; with BTC near $64.5k, its 850,849-coin stack sits roughly 14% below the ~$75.5k average cost.
Solana is shedding its 'mainnet beta' label, and Zelle plans to run its ZelleUSD stablecoin on the network; SOL leads majors with a 3% gain.
Perp DEX Lighter says it recovered about 5m USDC and resumed withdrawals after a breach tied to compromised API keys.
The US Supreme Court declined Custodia Bank's appeal, leaving regional Fed banks free to refuse master accounts to crypto-focused lenders.

upcoming.note: Exp 3.6% y/y, prev 3.5%; key for a December BoE hike.
Rates held at 3.75–4.00% with two dissents for a hike.
Range $70–78; Nasdaq debut as 'ANT' expected Thu 19 Nov.
Announced by the Kremlin; Ukraine and trade on the agenda.
